verdict.rationale: Xero documents its own public API, with official OpenAPI descriptions, an SDK covering small-business and general-ledger accounting data, and an official MCP server for contacts, chart of accounts and invoices. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI's full feature set, and UI features like JAX AI reconciliation, dashboards, benchmarking and bill-file export have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: evidence of API-UI parity, API coverage for UI-only features (JAX reconciliation, dashboards/KPIs, benchmarking, payment-file export), independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An OpenAPI (Swagger) specification for the Xero API with OAuth 2.0 security schema.
The xero-node SDK makes it easy for developers to access Xero's APIs in their JavaScript code, and build robust applications and software using small business & general ledger accounting data.
